> Did you profile this before and after? I'm skeptical that this makes a meaningful difference. I just don't think the changed functions are in any tight loops.

As the title says. reduce once operation about get data from map. Since the map[key] supply the tuple response api, why need check the key is exists firstly, then get the data?

> Since the map[key] supply the tuple response api, why need check the key is exists firstly, then get the data?

This clearly reduces the amount of work done, but that doesn't mean it's a large enough effect to "pay for" the cost to those having to adjust to the new interface.

> This clearly reduces the amount of work done, but that doesn't mean it's a large enough effect to "pay for" the cost to those having to adjust to the new interface.

I'm agree with you, but I don't know which code need to adjust, is `staging/src/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/fields/fields.go:25` need adjust?

line_221 -> line_224. It judge the lable is exist firstly, if the lable exist, then get data from map.
